messages:
samir: hey @support I'm seeing a token mismatch between dashboard (2.1k tokens) and invoice (6.3k) for session abc123. We were streaming responses and client canceled mid-gen. any idea how partial streams are metered? attaching small dump

devon-support: can you paste the session id + approximate times? also did you use server-sent events (SSE) or websockets?

samir: session=abc123 ts=2026-03-15T16:12:34Z, client disconnect code=499, transport=SSE. quick snippet of the stream:

samir: ```
data: {"role":"assistant","delta":"Hello"}
data: {"role":"assistant","delta":" there"}
# client closed connection here
``` 

ashley-eng: fyi token accounting pipeline expects a final `[DONE]` event to trigger KV-cache flush and token_finalize. If client drops before [DONE] we may still have partial counts in both streaming and finalization pass -> possible double-count.

maria.ops: @ashley can you confirm whether the billing pipeline dedupes partial vs finalized telemetry? I see a +4.2k token delta on invoice for that day.

billing-bot: invoice 2026-03-15 for customer samir-corp: dashboard tokens=2,148; billed tokens=6,379; discrepancy=4,231

ashley-eng: quick diag: there are two places we emit token counts: streaming_metrics (per-chunk) and finalization_metrics (on completion). bug: when client cancels we don't mark stream as aborted, so finalizer retries and emits a synthetic final count leading to overcount in some edge cases.

lee-devx: repro script (curl SSE) -> ensure to simulate midstream close:

lee-devx: ```bash
#!/bin/bash
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/streams" -d @prompt.json &
sleep 0.6
kill $! # simulate client abort
```

devon-support: next steps: 1) eng to add a guard to not emit finalizer counts if stream aborted; 2) run backfill to subtract duplicates for customers with session pattern abc*; 3) credit affected invoices. owner: @ashley for fix, @maria.ops for billing credits.

ashley-eng: ack. I'll push a hotfix to mark aborted streams and stop finalizer emission. also adding unit test for SSE partial path. will create PR and tag @devon for validation.

maria.ops: I'll collate affected invoices and propose credits. can you produce a list of session ids matching `session=abc*` by end of day? If we have >50 customers affected we'll do org-wide comms.

samir: thanks! for now a customer-facing note to say we're investigating would be great :eyes:

devon-support: posted public status thread in #support-updates. closing loop once credits posted.

ashley-eng: root cause: duplicate emission when client cancels before finalization; mitigation plan: fix in runtime + reconciliation job. ETA patch: 6 hours, backfill job: 24 hours.

maria.ops: assigned FIN ticket FIN-492 for crediting and reconciliation. I'll follow up after backfill run.

samir: appreciate the quick turnaround :thumbsup:
